title: One skill ledger: each JD skill corroborated by a named repo, or not reached
deviations_from_card: (1) The skill taxonomy (SKILL_ALIASES, tokenizer, aliasMatches, canonicalSkill) MOVED from skills.ts into the new skill-ledger.ts. skills.ts imports it and re-exports canonicalSkill. Reason: the client panel importing skills.ts pulled heuristics.ts and repo-activity.ts onto app/page.tsx (+4 modules / 29 KB). After the move it is +1 module / 16 KB. (2) A second nullish jobFitSignals field, undeterminedSkills. On a partial run potentialGaps is [] (unchanged), so without this field the ledger could not name which JD skills were not determined; the card's could-not-determine case needs it. Legacy payloads fall back to the review's unverifiedClaims under EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE. (3) perf-budget.json: app/page.tsx ceiling +1 module / +16 KB (my measured share, under the lock, with a why). (4) The 12 catalog keys that only the old five lists used were removed in a separate lock commit. (5) The catalogs commit landed before the test commit, and the doc commit before the feat commit (lock-first ordering).
notes: 14 cases red before (both test files failed to load), 14 green after. They cover the card's 8 acceptance lines plus the undetermined-skills, language-mix-only, ordering and hidden-strength-dedupe cases. Full test:unit: 10065/10066. The single BROKEN is app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts ('an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree'); it is not in my write set and passes 3/3 when run alone. tsc: 0 errors on my paths. The remaining errors were in untracked kpi-sim/ and a sibling's in-flight analytics files, and they were gone on the final run apart from kpi-sim. test:perf is RED on the shared tree: page.tsx is at 1400 modules / 8815 KB against 1398 / 8774, and about 12 routes are 1-9 KB over. Measured on 3993c0adc with only my files swapped in, every route is inside its ceiling and page.tsx is 1393 / 8734. My raise covers that, so every remaining overage comes from siblings' uncommitted work. DevEvalPanelProcessTrace.tsx (null decisions log shown as 'missing' in coral) is not in or near my write set, so it was left for slot A's follow-up. Also outside this card: app/features/hiring/pipeline/PipelineGithubEvidenceCard.tsx still shows the frozen review's unverifiedClaims under an amber 'Unverified claims:' label (pipeline.githubUnverified, over github-summary.ts). Same accusatory-column defect, noted in docs/features/candidates/README.md. The panel was not checked visually in either theme (no dev server per the brief). It uses tokens only: moss/15, CHIP_QUIET, amber-50/800, limewash, no coral.
